doc.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Greeting and listening to 'First Flight Out'
summary: Monk Rowe welcomes McPherson, plays a track, and McPherson names the personnel on 'First Flight Out'.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We’re interviewing Charles McPherson today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive — great saxophonist and composer. And I’m very pleased to have you here.
You are a fellow I’ve listened to over the years myself.
Along with Cannonball and Charlie Parker, and you were on my playlist.
Oh, well I’m in good company.
So it’s a pleasure. I wanted to actually listen to something here. I got this —
That’s “First Flight Out,” Tom Harrell and Peter Washington, Victor Lewis on drums, Michael Weiss on piano and myself, and did I say Tom Harrell?
